AC_SGA2.author: Grothendieck, Alexander
AC_SGA2.title: Cohomologie locale des faisceaux cohérents et théorèmes de Lefschetz locaux et globaux (SGA 2)
AC_SGA2.locator: Exposé IV, Proposition 1.1, Proposition 1.3, Théorème 1.4, Proposition 2.1, Corollaire 2.2; 2005 reprint pp.34–37, original pp.44–48
AC_SGA2.scope: Exact finite-module Hom representation, torsion colimit, support detection and torsion injectivity. The printed target is abelian groups; arbitrary abelian target extensions are separately reconstructed.

AC_RaynaudSGA2XIV.author: Raynaud, Michèle
AC_RaynaudSGA2XIV.title: Profondeur et théorèmes de Lefschetz en cohomologie étale, Exposé XIV of SGA 2
AC_RaynaudSGA2XIV.locator: XIV §1: Proposition 1.1, Corollaries 1.3–1.4, Remark 1.6(a), Théorème 1.8; reprint pp.160–167, original pp.205–217
AC_RaynaudSGA2XIV.scope: Printed byline Mme M. Raynaud; footnote explicitly says based on unpublished notes of A. Grothendieck. Étale sheaves and strict localizations, compared with the draft’s Zariski/spectral setting; no blanket equivalence of the two formulations.

AC_StacksTensor.author: {The Stacks Project Authors}
AC_StacksTensor.title: Lemma 19.14.1, tensor left adjoint
AC_StacksTensor.locator: Tag 0F5S, second proof, free presentation and cokernel construction
AC_StacksTensor.dates: Current version accessed 19 November 2026; no priority inference
AC_StacksTensor.scope: Construction in a Grothendieck abelian category. The finite-presentation version needs only finite sums/cokernels and is proved independently here.

AC_StacksCoh.author: {The Stacks Project Authors}
AC_StacksCoh.title: Coherent sheaves on Noetherian schemes
AC_StacksCoh.scope: Support annihilation, Artin–Rees, filtered union of coherent submodules. Ind-representability itself is reconstructed from these facts and the category of elements.

AC_StacksStack.author: {The Stacks Project Authors}
AC_StacksStack.title: Stacks
AC_StacksStack.scope: Separates the Hom-sheaf condition from effective object descent. The three-point counterexample is ours.

AC_GrothRearrangements1955.author: Grothendieck, Alexandre
AC_GrothRearrangements1955.title: Réarrangements de fonctions et inégalités de convexité dans les algèbres de von Neumann munies d'une trace
AC_GrothRearrangements1955.dates: Talk printed March 1955; Numdam volume year 1956; final printed annotation June 1957. These are not collapsed into a manuscript date.
AC_GrothRearrangements1955.scope: Whole short paper read. Proposition 3: Pólya support representation; §4 Proposition 5 and corollaries: trace rearrangements; §5 Théorème 1 and corollaries: log-majorization, Hölder, symmetric gauges; §6: determinant and p-subadditivity.

AC_GrothFredholm1956.author: Grothendieck, Alexander
AC_GrothFredholm1956.title: La théorie de Fredholm
AC_GrothFredholm1956.locator: Introduction pp.319–320; I §§1–2 pp.325–330; II §1 p.342; Fredholm theorem/resolvent pp.361–364
AC_GrothFredholm1956.dates: Introduction dates writing to 1952, acceptance by Summa to 1953, and publication here to 1956
AC_GrothFredholm1956.scope: Exterior and fundamental forms, projective tensors, contour/Riesz decomposition read. The paper expressly calls the exposition didactic and credits Ruston and Schatten; its mere presence is not evidence for priority of every archival lemma.

AC_FackKosaki1986.author: Fack, Thierry and Kosaki, Hideki
AC_FackKosaki1986.title: Generalized s-numbers of tau-measurable operators
AC_FackKosaki1986.dates: Pacific Journal of Mathematics 123(2), 1986, pp.269–300; separate circulation date not verified
AC_FackKosaki1986.scope: Exact generalized singular values, all-positive-exponent Hölder, convex and concave partial-integral inequalities, noncommutative Lp, Clarkson inequalities. The paper itself warns that earlier real-variable Clarkson proofs were incorrect; they are not used here.

AC_BourinUchiyama2007.author: Bourin, Jean-Christophe and Uchiyama, Mitsuru
AC_BourinUchiyama2007.title: A matrix subadditivity inequality for f(A+B) and f(A)+f(B)
AC_BourinUchiyama2007.dates: PDF dated 4 December 2006; arXiv submission 16 February 2007; journal bibliographic details not used
AC_BourinUchiyama2007.scope: Nonnegative concave functions, symmetric norms, and a unitary-orbit inequality for arbitrary matrices. Does not prove the false aligned singular-value sum in claim042.

AC_Ricard2018.author: Ricard, Éric
AC_Ricard2018.title: Fractional powers on noncommutative Lp for p less than 1
AC_Ricard2018.dates: arXiv v1 15 May 2018; Advances in Mathematics 333 (2018), pp.194–211
AC_Ricard2018.scope: All p>0 Hölder continuity with a constant for absolute/signed powers. Introduction states the older constant-one positive-power result only when the input exponent q is at least the power θ; that restriction is decisive.

AC_Dodds1995.author: Dodds, P. G. and Dodds, T. K. and Dowling, P. N. and Lennard, C. J. and Sukochev, F. A.
AC_Dodds1995.title: A uniform Kadec-Klee property for symmetric operator spaces
AC_Dodds1995.locator: Theorem 2.7, Corollary 2.8 and following paragraph; arXiv text explicitly includes all Schatten exponents 0<p<infinity
AC_Dodds1995.dates: arXiv 28 January 1993; Mathematical Proceedings of the Cambridge Philosophical Society 118(3), November 1995, pp.487–502. Publisher online date 2008 is not first publication.
AC_Dodds1995.scope: Weak-operator Kadec–Klee for all positive Schatten exponents, including quasi-Banach range; uniform convexity is a different assertion.

AC_Antezana2011.author: Antezana, Jorge and Larotonda, Gabriel and Varela, Alejandro
AC_Antezana2011.title: Short paths for symmetric norms in the unitary group
AC_Antezana2011.dates: Version read dated 18 July 2011; first arXiv identifier January 2010, exact v1 day not checked
AC_Antezana2011.scope: Minimal/maximal symmetric ideals and polar trace norms. Full Banach-dual identification in the manuscript is independently proved, not attributed wholesale to this paper.

AC_Wiegerinck2009.author: Wiegerinck, Jan
AC_Wiegerinck2009.title: Advanced Function Theory
AC_Wiegerinck2009.dates: Author course text version 15 July 2009; the named classical theorems predate these archival analyses
AC_Wiegerinck2009.scope: Jensen, canonical product order and Hadamard factorization. The source is a checked modern exposition, not a primary nineteenth-century priority source.

AC_Fulton2000.author: Fulton, William
AC_Fulton2000.title: Eigenvalues, invariant factors, highest weights, and Schubert calculus
AC_Fulton2000.dates: arXiv v1 2 August 1999; final v3 27 March 2000; Bulletin AMS 37 (2000), pp.209–249
AC_Fulton2000.scope: Complete complex-matrix sum singular-value feasibility via Horn index sets. Product Theorem 16 is not relied on because its extracted total-product condition was not independently adjudicated.

AC_Tam2010.author: Tam, Tin-Yau
AC_Tam2010.title: A. Horn's result on matrices with prescribed singular values and eigenvalues
AC_Tam2010.dates: Received 10 June 2009; accepted 31 July 2010; Electronic Journal of Linear Algebra 21, October 2010
AC_Tam2010.scope: Weyl product inequalities plus full-product equality characterize finite eigenvalue/singular-value data; original Horn result credited, not newly attributed to this paper.

AC_Reinov2012.author: Reinov, Oleg
AC_Reinov2012.title: Some more remarks on Grothendieck–Lidskiĭ trace formulas
AC_Reinov2012.locator: pp.5–6 history; theorem/proof pp.7–9; p.10 Remark quoting Grothendieck 1955 II p.21 Remark 4
AC_Reinov2012.dates: Journal of Prime Research in Mathematics 8 (2012), pp.5–11; paper ends 28 March 2012; journal page posted 31 December 2012
AC_Reinov2012.scope: Trace formula including the Hilbert r=1,p=2 case; precise lead to Grothendieck’s published spectral-continuity assertion. Separate manuscript priority is not inferred.

AC_Daws2010.author: Daws, Matthew
AC_Daws2010.title: Multipliers, self-induced and dual Banach algebras
AC_Daws2010.scope: Multiplier and idealizer framework; C*-bidual specialization proved directly here, with essentiality needed for injectivity of an arbitrary ambient idealizer action.

AC_ZagorodnyukHihliuk2021.author: Zagorodnyuk, Andriy and Hihliuk, Anna
AC_ZagorodnyukHihliuk2021.title: Entire Analytic Functions of Unbounded Type on Banach Spaces and Their Lineability
AC_ZagorodnyukHihliuk2021.locator: §1 definitions of entire functions, bounded type and uniform radius
AC_ZagorodnyukHihliuk2021.scope: Modern distinction between entire holomorphy and bounded type. The exact function sum n!e_n is verified here independently, not claimed to occur in this paper.

AC_GrothPTT1955.author: Grothendieck, Alexander
AC_GrothPTT1955.title: Produits tensoriels topologiques et espaces nucléaires
AC_GrothPTT1955.locator: Chapter II §1 no.4, printed p.13; Remark4 printed pp.20–21, especially p.21; one-based physical pages214,221–222
AC_GrothPTT1955.dates: Memoirs of the American Mathematical Society16, copyright1955; the inspected copy is explicitly fourth printing1966 (front matter physical2–3); no separate circulation date inferred here
AC_GrothPTT1955.scope: Published text visually read in the image-only fourth printing1966. Printed p13 credits Weyl and states the Hilbert spectral p-bound and genus-zero determinant for p<=1. Printed p21 defines the matching space Sigma(p) and states Hilbert spectral-list continuity for0<p<=1, in the broader Banach p-nuclear discussion; the argument is a sketch, not a full supplied proof.

AC_StacksAmple.author: {The Stacks Project Authors}
AC_StacksAmple.title: Ample invertible sheaves
AC_StacksAmple.dates: Current version accessed19November2026; no historical priority inferred
AC_StacksAmple.scope: Global generation of every finite-type quasi-coherent sheaf after all sufficiently large positive twists, exactly the ample-twist step in claim003.
